EmailTemplate.subject: Important information regarding a course override in the Department of Physics
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
{!Contact.FirstName},
Please read the directions carefully and complete the appropriate Course Override Form found here. You can also locate the form under the current students tab, titled "Course Override Form" on the Department of Physics site.
Once your override has been received it will be processed within 24-48 hours.
Sincerely,
Department of Physics Arizona State University
